questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned} \text{总体的概率函数为} \quad & P\{X=k\}=\frac{\lambda^k}{k!}e^{-\lambda}, k=0,1,2,\cdots, \\ \text{设}x_1,x_2,\cdots,x_n \text{为从总体中抽取的容量为}n \text{的样本，则似然函数为} \quad & L(x_1,x_2,\cdots,x_n;\lambda)=\prod_{i=1}^n f(x_i;\lambda)=\prod_{i=1}^n \frac{\lambda^i}{x_i!}e^{-\lambda}=\frac{\sum_{i=1}^n x_i}{\prod_{i=1}^n x_i!}e^{-n\lambda}, \\ & \ln L=(\sum_{i=1}^n x_i)\ln\lambda-n\lambda-\sum_{i=1}^n \ln x_i!, \\ \text{令} \frac{d\ln L}{d\lambda}=\frac{1}{\lambda}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i-n=0, \text{得} \quad & \widehat{\lambda}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n x_i=\overline{x}, \\ \text{即} \widehat{\lambda}=\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^n X_i \text{就是参数} \lambda \text{的最大似然估计.} \end{aligned}

questions.analysis_html: \begin{aligned}X\text{的分布律为}\qquad\qquad P\{X=x\}&=p^*(1-p)^{1-x},\, x=0,1. \\\text{设}x_1,x_2,\cdots,x_n\text{是}X_1,X_2,\cdots,X_n\text{的一组样本值，似然函数为}\qquad\qquad L(p)=\prod_{i=1}^np^{x_i}(1-p)^{1-x_i}=p^{\sum_{i=1}^n x_i}(1-p)^{n-\sum_{i=1}^n x_i}, \\\qquad\qquad\qquad\qquad\ln L(p)&=\left(\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\right)\ln p+\left(n-\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\right)\ln(1-p), \\\text{令}\qquad\qquad\qquad\frac{d}{dp}\ln L(p)&=\left(\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\right)/p-\left(n-\sum_{i=1}^n x_i\right)/(1-p)=0. \end{aligned}
